about: #3767: production answers for a CVE that only the CVE record's CNA names a package for (#3757, served by production from 2026-11-11), read on 2026-11-11 between 14:32Z and 14:48Z through scripts/probe-prod.sh: match, GET /api/v1/public/cves/match for npm suneditor 3.3.0 (each description cut to its first sentence); remediation_affected and remediation_not_assessed, GET /api/v1/public/cves/CVE-2026-124494/remediation with the installed version 3.3.0 and 3.4.0, whole. Read on 2026-11-11 at 15:21Z through scripts/probe-prod.sh (#3767's review), whole: match_not_in_corpus, GET /api/v1/public/cves/match for Maven org.apache.tomee:openejb-http 11.0.0 (assessed false, package_not_in_advisory_corpus, its 7 CVEs named only by CNA purls, none calling 11.0.0 affected); match_cleared, the same for npm suneditor 3.4.0 (assessed true, not_affected_count 4, two of the four on VulnCheck's CNA records alone, which cve_remediation answers not_assessed: #3825). cna_only_not_assessed is not read from production (synthetic): it is core-backend's MatchByPackage answer (internal/cve/pkgmatch.go) for a package no advisory record names and none of whose CNA-only records calls the version affected, written here in that shape: assessed false, package_not_in_advisory_corpus, the CNA records counted in advisories_considered, not_affected_count and undetermined (reasons cna_range_status_unknown and cna_range_undecidable_scheme, with the sentences of pkgmatch_cnapurl.go).
